Sailing is an escape from everything I do on land. My job especially. It is so easy to be swept up in bullshit--the internet, the job, family drama, etc. Sailing is about sailing. About the journey. You can turn it all off and listen to yourself. I have said it on this we site, perhaps more than once, that you realize things about yourself on a sailboat that you wouldn't otherwise.

I have done some camping, and the feeling is similar. You learn how to filter out the external noise, and feel emotions that you can easily overlook. I think it actually takes getting out on the water to undrstand what I am trying to impart.

The cool thing about sailing is that you make out of it what you want. If you want to crew a 200' star class cutter you can, or a teensy tiny Hobie, that is available too. For little to no money you can have a customized experience...

I ramble. tl;dr: sail

Sailing is something I've enjoyed a few times but with others doing the actual work of sailing.
